family.description: This family represents a transcriptional cell cycle regulator (TrcR) found in Proteobacteria, mainly Alphaproteobacteria. It has been shown to associate with promoters and coding sequences in vivo in a rifampicin-dependent manner and to interact physically and genetically with RNA polymerase, resulting in the integration of cell cycle and antibiotic stress control with the general transcriptional machinery [[cite:PUB00098048]].
family.name: Transcriptional cell cycle regulator TrcR
